results_grid_sprint_race_only_check.name: results_grid_sprint_race_only_check
results_grid_sprint_race_only_check.value: "results"."session_kind" in ('sprint', 'race') or ("results"."grid" is null and "results"."pit_lane_start" = false)

results_q_times_qualifying_only_check.name: results_q_times_qualifying_only_check
results_q_times_qualifying_only_check.value: "results"."session_kind" in ('qualifying', 'sprint_qualifying') or ("results"."q1_ms" is null and "results"."q2_ms" is null and "results"."q3_ms" is null)

pool_assets_one_subject_check.name: pool_assets_one_subject_check
pool_assets_one_subject_check.value:
("pool_assets"."asset_type" = 'driver' and "pool_assets"."driver_id" is not null and "pool_assets"."constructor_id" is null)
        or ("pool_assets"."asset_type" = 'constructor' and "pool_assets"."constructor_id" is not null and "pool_assets"."driver_id" is null)

leagues_auto_key_check.name: leagues_auto_key_check
leagues_auto_key_check.value:
("leagues"."kind" = 'auto_constructor' and "leagues"."constructor_id" is not null and "leagues"."driver_id" is null and "leagues"."country_code" is null)
        or ("leagues"."kind" = 'auto_driver' and "leagues"."driver_id" is not null and "leagues"."constructor_id" is null and "leagues"."country_code" is null)
        or ("leagues"."kind" = 'auto_country' and "leagues"."country_code" is not null and "leagues"."constructor_id" is null and "leagues"."driver_id" is null)
        or ("leagues"."kind" in ('global', 'public', 'private') and "leagues"."constructor_id" is null and "leagues"."driver_id" is null and "leagues"."country_code" is null)

leagues_user_only_check.name: leagues_user_only_check
leagues_user_only_check.value:
"leagues"."kind" in ('public', 'private')
        or ("leagues"."owner_user_id" is null and "leagues"."join_code" is null and "leagues"."max_members" is null
            and "leagues"."start_sequence" = 1 and "leagues"."end_sequence" is null)

leagues_name_check.name: leagues_name_check
leagues_name_check.value:
"leagues"."kind" not in ('public', 'private')
        or char_length("leagues"."name") between 1 and 40
